<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-09-0702-01-32" status="unreviewed">  yang shes pa'i mtshan nyid gsal ba'am rig pa yin na|_<quote><!--PV 3, PVin 3-->
       <lg>  <l>rnam rtog rjes su 'brel ba la||</l>
         <l>don gsal snang ba yod ma yin||</l></lg>
         </quote> zhes rtog pa mi gsal bar bshad pas rtog bcas kyi shes pa la ma khyab bo zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> zer te |
         gsal ba zhes bya ba mngon sum gsal snang gcig pu la mi zer gyi yul du byas pa tsam la 'dod la | de rtogs bcas kyi shes pa la'ang yod pas ma khyab pa'i skyon med do zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
